async def act(page):
    # Locate the price input field using the specific row and textbox roles
    price_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='Price * 160.00 [USD] [GLOBAL]')
    price_input = price_row.get_by_role('textbox', name='Price *')
    
    # Get the current price value
    current_price_str = await price_input.input_value()
    current_price = float(current_price_str)
    
    # Calculate the new price (reduce by 10%)
    new_price = current_price * 0.9
    new_price_str = f'{new_price:.2f}'  # Format to two decimal places
    
    # Set the new price
    await price_input.fill(new_price_str)
    
    # Save the changes
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save').click()
    
    # Wait for the save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # No further actions needed; the function will end
    return new_price_str
